answer: A decentralized AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a verified economic resource, functioning much like securing a ship at a wharf where unauthorized vessels are barred from the jetty. Attackers must stake native tokens on a computational mesa to validate network participation, imposing a capital expenditure proportional to the desired influence. This economic friction drains attacker funds, making mass-identity fabrication cost-prohibitive.
